Cause: a product holds its own stock number and a stock per size, nothing keeps them equal, and a one-size product files its stock under a stand-in size ("Free Size") — so the brand is asked twice and the shopper app listens to the second answer. DONE ON HIS GO THE SAME DAY (live data, not a deploy): the ten sunglasses listed 9 Oct were repaired by backend/scripts/repair-one-size-stock.js (each product's own number copied into its one size; 13 checks OK; read back from the live server as in stock).
